evidenceLayout: tmp/fst/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ holds one full log per verification command, each ending with an exit=<status> line. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. tmp/ is gitignored (**/tmp) and is never listed in writePaths. A missing or truncated log is not a pass. A step blocked by the sandbox (network, ~/.cache/tree-sitter, full nextest) is recorded as BLOCKED with the command, exit code and stderr; FST-40 reruns it.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits the accepted design and all plans before fanout, and commits implementation after review. Commit messages use the AGENTS.md 1-6 sections. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge. Only wf/syntax-fmt is pushed; never main.
executionModel.retryPolicy: Wave-2 plans share one cargo target dir. If cargo reports a build-directory lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker. A compile error located in another concurrent plan's writePaths (for example FST-21's `--features lsp` build compiling FST-20's in-progress src/cli, or FST-23's wasm build compiling FST-22's in-progress src/host/wasm) is transient: never edit that file; wait about 120 s and retry up to 10 times, then record it as BLOCKED for FST-40. npm commands in editor/ are run only by FST-23 (install) and FST-30 in a later wave, so they do not contend.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and a one-line intent snapshot in the plan's Progress Log. After the edit, record the post-edit sha256. If the file drifted from the last recorded hash, stop and report. Never edit outside writePaths. Each worker edits only its own plan's Progress Log.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: FST-40 owns README.md, impl-plans/README.md, plan archiving, the design doc Status line, reruns of BLOCKED steps and the full gate. Formatting is limited to rustfmt on each plan's own .rs files. A defect found outside a worker's writePaths is recorded in that worker's Progress Log and repaired serially by FST-40 or by the orchestrator's review step, with file, cause, fix and pre/post sha256.

designDecisionsAndRationale: Formatter gate (design 3.1): reader::read with FileId 1 and an empty AliasEnv; any Error diagnostic means Refused with byte-identical output, so the formatter never reasons about text the reader rejects.

Rules R1-R9 (design 3.3): tabs one per level, `>` continuation at F+1 carrying any block it opens, trailing blanks stripped except on directive lines, intra-line text untouched because whitespace is lexically significant, blank lines kept, per-line terminators kept, no wrapping. Minimal and least surprising.
Code-line levels via a frame stack (design 3.4) that mirrors layout.rs statement()/block(), so formatted output is a fixed point.
Comment-only lines use a binding-preserving indentation rule over the statement chain (design 3.5), so #@ directives keep their directives::attach target (G6).

LSP format_edits keeps its signature and is re-implemented on crate::fmt::format (design 3.7.2); wasm uses a raw ABI export fmt_source/fmt_out_ptr/fmt_out_len beside the existing session ABI (design 3.7.3).

Tree-sitter grammar is an editor-side superset (design 4.1) with a C scanner emitting NEWLINE/INDENT/DEDENT; built by CLI 0.27.0 which fetches wasi-sdk/binaryen, so no emscripten or docker (design 2, 6).
Editor keeps StreamLanguage as the default and swaps to tree-sitter only after the loader resolves (design 5.2); missing grammar wasm at build warns and falls back (F2).
Pending user decisions F1-F5 follow the recommendations by default (pending-formatter-syntax-questions.md).
intentionalTradeoffs: No intra-line spacing normalization (R6): less normalization in exchange for zero risk of changing lexing.
Blank-line runs are not collapsed (F1/R7), matching the interim LSP formatter and keeping all committed files fixed points.
Sources using console-bound import aliases are refused (F4), because they are also load errors as files.
Highlighting reparses the whole document instead of incremental tree.edit, for simplicity in v1.
Command naming drift: design 3.7.1 says Command::Fmt { check, inputs } while FST-20 pins Command::Fmt { check, input: FmtInput }; the plan contract governs and FST-40 may align the design text.
supportedEdgeCases: `>` continuation lines at any original depth, including continuations that open `:` blocks.
Own-line comments and #@ directives at odd indentation, including tab/space mixes on comment-only lines.
Pairs `name: value`, lambdas `->:`, `:kw:` block openers, `slot :drums gain: 0.8:`, if/elif/else chains.
Strings with nested interpolation, escapes, `#` and `}` inside strings; path and url literals; ratio and negative numbers; `_` and `_1`; qualified identifiers; `a->b`; `>=` at a line start.
CRLF line ends, missing final newline, whitespace-only lines, empty input, leading blank lines.
Reader-error input (mixed indentation on code lines, unterminated strings, unbound qualifiers) is returned unchanged; non-UTF-8 bytes return status 2 from format_bytes.
Grammar wasm missing or failing to load in the editor: StreamLanguage fallback.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Formatting sources the reader rejects, including console-alias-dependent documents.
Tree-sitter-based indentation, locals or folding queries.
residualRisks: Scanner/reader disagreement on edge layout forms; mitigated by the corpus and parse-all.
The runtime wasm name in web-tree-sitter 0.27.0 must be confirmed from the installed package.
The Codex sandbox may block npm network access or ~/.cache/tree-sitter; such steps are recorded BLOCKED and rerun by FST-40.
FST-10 mutation test 10 s debug budget may be tight given src/prelude/templates.vact (54,788 bytes); weight mutants toward smaller files if needed.
ts-test fails if query output prints 'error'; highlight-sample.txt must not contain that word.
FST-21: on whitespace-only lines the indent-run edit and the trailing-blank edit could overlap; covered by the existing test and the apply==format corpus test.
How tree-sitter CLI 0.27.0 selects the language for parse/query outside the grammar dir is unconfirmed; FST-11 checks --help and routes failures to BLOCKED for FST-40.
